scripts.dev: npm run validate:data && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro dev --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.check: npm run validate:data && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check && tsc --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run validate:data && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && ../.venv/bin/python -B scripts/scan_dist.py
scripts.preview: npm run validate:data && ../.venv/bin/python -B scripts/scan_dist.py && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro preview --host 0.0.0.0
